subtypes.name: Jungle
subtypes.setting: Dense jungle, vines, humid air, distant howls, half-buried ruins of a forgotten civilisation.
subtypes.hook: The player has a torn map fragment showing a temple at the jungle's heart — something valuable is hidden there.

cast.description: Knows the jungle better than anyone. Hiding something about why they agreed to help.
Charming and ruthless. Wants the artefact for themselves.
A villager who insists the player turn back.

subtypes.goal: Reach the inner chamber of the temple and decide what to do with what's inside.

beats.title: Arrival
beats.description: Meet the guide at the jungle's edge. Hear the warning from a local.

beats.title: Obstacle
beats.description: Cross a chasm, solve a ruin puzzle, or face a wild animal.

beats.title: Rivalry
beats.description: Encounter the rival. Choice point: cooperate, deceive, or confront.

beats.title: Discovery
beats.description: Reach the chamber. A twist about what the artefact really is.

subtypes.tone: Pulpy adventure-serial. Indiana Jones energy. Exclamations, dramatic descriptions, sweat and danger.
subtypes.choiceFlavour: Trust vs suspicion of allies. Brave vs cautious in danger. Keep vs return the artefact.
